description: This file defines a template class 'MeasurementType' used for measuring and tracking statistical data (min, max, last, average, count) for a generic data type. It includes methods for resetting, setting new values, and retrieving statistical metrics. The class is part of the WPEFramework::Core namespace and depends on external modules 'Number' and 'Module'.

classes.name: MeasurementType
classes.description: A template class for measuring and tracking statistical data (min, max, last, average, count) for a generic data type.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the measurement statistics to initial state.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Updates the measurement with a new value, adjusting min, max, last, and average accordingly.

methods.name: Average
methods.description: Returns the average of all recorded values.

methods.name: Measurements
methods.description: Returns the total number of measurements taken.
